title: Unknown vendor and a department with no budget record

decision.recommendation: Escalate for review: The request cannot proceed until budget verification and vendor risk/legal assessments are completed; it should be escalated for review.

No software budget record for Go To Market; budget cannot be verified
Annual amount $9,000 falls in tier requiring Department Head and Procurement approvals
Vendor DeckGenie not in internal vendor registry (new vendor)
External vendor-risk service has no assessment for DeckGenie

decision.next_step: Escalate to Security and Legal for vendor risk assessment and to Finance/Department Head to verify or establish a software budget for Go To Market.
